div.div: رَوْثٌ , (T, S, M, &c.,) originally an inf. n., (Msb,) The dung (M, Msb *) of the horse (S, Msb, K) and the like, (Msb,) [i. e.] of a solidhoofed animal (T, M, A, Mgh) of any kind: (T, Mgh:) [a coll. gen. n.:] n. un. ↓ رَوْثَةٌ : (S, Msb, K:) and pl. أَرْوَاثٌ. (S, M, A, Mgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
